decision: Sysinternals is cleared for RIDE package migration under the prior RIDE v2 license-specialist approval for direct download and installation.
practical_scope: RIDE obtains Sysinternals directly from Microsoft for deployment. RIDE does not transfer or publish copies.
user_statement: There are no legal issues using Sysinternals in RIDE. Do not use strict or generalized redistribution reasoning to block package migration.
migration_effect: No additional license review, redistribution analysis, or NeedsReview marker is required. Current ten package plans remain eligible.
separate_security_exclusion: Defender-blocked utilities remain excluded; this security disposition is independent of licensing.
remaining_acceptance: Technical source, lifecycle, functional, and Windows target acceptance remain separate.
estimate: Unchanged: settings 37-57; packages 40-55; components 19-24; files/assets 25-35; maintenance 8-12; exact 129-183; rounded 130-185/about 155.
